form.limitInvalidCreate: Daily quota / rate limit must be non-negative integers (leave empty or 0 = unlimited)
form.limitInvalidEdit: Daily quota / rate limit must be non-negative integers (0 = unlimited)
form.nameHint: Used to identify the purpose, e.g. "CI release script"
form.rateHint: Excess requests are queued or rejected with 429
form.createNote: The full plaintext key is shown only once after creation — prepare a place to save it now.

reveal.title: Key Created
reveal.bodySuffix: was created successfully. The full plaintext is below:
reveal.warning: Save it now: the full key is shown only this once. Once closed it cannot be viewed again — you will have to delete the key and create a new one.
reveal.closeWarning: After closing, the plaintext key will no longer be shown. Make sure you have saved it safely.

delete.title: Delete API Key
delete.confirmPrefix: Are you sure you want to delete key
delete.note: This cannot be undone. Programs calling /v1/send with this key will receive 401 Unauthorized.

edit.title: Edit Key — {{name}}
edit.testHint: Send test uses the saved URL
edit.webhookDesc: Once configured, accepted/terminal-failure results of send calls made with this key are POSTed as JSON to the address below, so unattended pipelines can archive them (the synchronous API response already includes the result).
edit.urlRequired: Webhook URL must start with http:// or https://
edit.webhookUrlHint: Leave empty to disable push; only http(s):// addresses are supported
edit.secretDesc: Receipt requests carry the X-CatMail-Signature header signed with this secret (HMAC-SHA256, ±5 min clock skew); update the receiver's verification secret after rotation.
edit.secretRotateConfirm: Rotate the signing secret for this key? The receiver must update its verification secret afterwards.
edit.eventsWarning: URL is set but no event is selected: nothing will be pushed after saving.

events.sendAcceptedDesc: Pushed after the platform accepts a message (includes provider_message_id and elapsed time)
events.sendFailedDesc: Pushed after 429 quota/rate limits or when all candidate channels are exhausted (400 parameter errors are not pushed)

toast.secretRotated: Signing secret rotated — the receiver must update its verification secret
toast.copyFailedManual: Copy failed — select and copy manually
